bookings_has_origin.name: bookings_has_origin
bookings_has_origin.value: "bookings"."lead_id" is not null or "bookings"."departure_id" is not null

customers_reachable.name: customers_reachable
customers_reachable.value: "customers"."phone_key" is not null or "customers"."email_key" is not null

hotel_rates_extra_bed.name: hotel_rates_extra_bed
hotel_rates_extra_bed.value: "hotel_rates"."extra_bed_cost_paise" is null or "hotel_rates"."extra_bed_sell_paise" is null or "hotel_rates"."extra_bed_sell_paise" >= "hotel_rates"."extra_bed_cost_paise"

trips_live_when_visible.name: trips_live_when_visible
trips_live_when_visible.value: "trips"."status" not in ('internal', 'published') or "trips"."live" is not null
